name: browser-use
description: Control websites through the Aha Browser Use backend with `browser_use`, `plane="bu"`, and `aha_browser_use`. Use whenever the user asks to open or navigate a web page, inspect visible content or UI state, click, type, select, upload or download files, take screenshots, manage tabs, test a web flow, or troubleshoot browser behavior. Also use for Taobao/Tmall, Weibo, and Xiaohongshu workflows. Site references provide business rules only. Whenever login, reauthentication, QR/SMS/OTP, CAPTCHA, identity verification, or user takeover is required, always call `interaction.request_action` with `type="browserControl"`; never rely on a text-only login request.
